# task\-events\-jsonl\-newline\-defence — Defend events\.jsonl appends against missing trailing newline
status: done  priority: 1  scope: scope-core
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_done
commits: 9daa8ec42ac96e21d72069b764442f87bc54d26c

When a process appends an event to \.waystation/events\.jsonl and the previous writer left no trailing newline, the new JSON object is concatenated onto the last line, producing a line with two \}\{\-joined objects\. validate then reports \`events\.jsonl line N: invalid JSON\`\. Observed in production on 2026\-08\-15 \(lines 250, 253, 257\) after events written by different agents/CLI versions; one 16:09 event was itself left unterminated, triggering the next writer's concatenation\.

Requirements:
\- appendEventUnlocked must guarantee the previous content ends with \\n before writing the new line \(read\-last\-byte check; never rely on the previous writer\)\.
\- Event writes must themselves end with a trailing newline\.
\- Make the invalid\_jsonl diagnostic hint actionable \(suggest the repair command\)\.
\- Add \`waystation repair\` \(core fn in src/core/repair\.ts\): detect \}\{\-concatenated lines in events\.jsonl, byte\-level split at each \}\{ boundary, rewrite with consistent trailing newlines, report what it fixed\. Idempotent, safe, no event loss\.
\- Regression tests: \(a\) append to unterminated file produces two valid lines \+ validate passes; \(b\) CLI\-written events leave file ending with \\n; \(c\) repair on seeded concatenated file restores N\+1 lines \+ validate passes; \(d\) repair is a no\-op on a clean ledger\.
\- Audit other line\-append surfaces \(messages, claims, anything JSONL\) and apply the same defence; do not change the event schema or existing line formats\.

## Acceptance
- appendEventUnlocked appends a leading newline when the existing events\.jsonl content is non\-empty and does not end with \\n; existing valid content is never modified\.
- Every event written via the CLI/core path leaves events\.jsonl ending with \\n\.
- validate's invalid\_jsonl hint suggests running \`waystation repair\`\.
- waystation repair splits \}\{\-concatenated events\.jsonl lines at each \}\{ boundary, restores one line per event, ends the file with \\n, and reports fixed lines; a no\-op on a clean ledger\.
- All four regression tests pass; full test suite, typecheck, and biome check are clean\.
- No other JSONL/line\-append surfaces exist unguarded \(audit done\); event schema and line formats unchanged\.
